_comment: REGRESSION SCENARIO: the unidirectional path through MotorGroup. All four channels are plain (non-bidirectional) DShot; channel 1's motor turns at throttle 100 while channels 2-4 idle - the 4-in-1 AM32 ESC only completes its arm handshake with a valid signal on all four. Nothing is read back, so this shows arming, a sustained command stream and disarm work; that the motor really turns is for the person watching (or a bidirectional scenario's eRPM check).
